about: Employer-board seed validation (scripts/board-seeds/validate.mjs): what each candidate board answered on the date below. Counts only. No posting title or text is stored: per board, the company name its own answer stated, the number of postings it listed, and the number per ISO country taken from the location fields. A candidate is a guess; only "valid": true makes it a fact. nameCheck says how the name was confirmed; "board_id_only" is a live board whose employer nothing confirms (it is listed under its board id), and nameSource is the document that confirms a board id for an employer where the system states no company name.
